description: This file defines classes and structures related to cgroup metrics, including memory and processor information, for process containers within the Thunder namespace. It includes classes for collecting memory usage and CPU core usage data from cgroup filesystem paths.

classes.name: CGroupMemoryInfo
classes.description: Represents memory information for a cgroup, including allocated, resident, and shared memory.

classes.name: CGroupProcessorInfo
classes.description: Represents CPU core usage information for a cgroup, including total usage and per-core usage.

classes.name: CGroupMetrics
classes.description: Helper class to collect and provide memory and processor metrics for a cgroup identified by name.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Reads memory usage and statistics from cgroup filesystem paths and returns an IMemoryInfo object.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Reads CPU core usage from cgroup filesystem paths and returns an IProcessorInfo object.
